led.name: LED
led.help: Sets the main pod's LEDs to a colour, all or selected ones. Continues at once.

delay.name: Wait
delay.help: Waits a fixed or random time.

button.name: Button
button.help: Waits for a press of the main pod's button. Only presses that start after the block began count.

if.name: If
if.help: Compares two values and continues at true or false.

setVariable.name: Set variable
setVariable.help: Sets, adds, subtracts or draws a random value.

remotePress.name: Light pod
remotePress.help: Lights one pod and waits for its press. The reaction time is measured on the pod.

remoteMultiPress.name: Light several pods
remoteMultiPress.help: Lights several pods at once, some may be red (do not press).

remoteResetAll.name: Pods off
remoteResetAll.help: Switches the pods (and the main pod) off.

summary.name: Summary
summary.help: Average, best and worst of a measurement, printed on the serial console. Can show the average as a bar on the ring for a few seconds.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.help: Runs the round (body) a number of times, then continues at done. The last step of the round leads back here.

effect.name: Light effect
effect.help: Plays an effect on the ring of the main pod, one pod or all pods. Continues at once, or waits until the effect is over. A later light on the same ring replaces it.

charge.name: Hold to charge
charge.help: The ring shows how long the button is held. Leave by release, when the charge is full or on a time limit. Needs firmware 2.9 on pods.

release.name: Let go
release.help: Trigger: letting go of the held button is the event. Signal: the colour switches after a time and the athlete lets go as fast as possible (false start if too early). Needs firmware 2.9 on pods.

toggle.name: Domination
toggle.help: Pods stay lit and flip between two team colours on every press. Ends when the time is up (next), or when every pod is team A (allA) or team B (allB). Needs firmware 2.10 on pods.

communicate.name: Report and answer
communicate.help: Sends the round result (the measurements since the last one) to the app, then waits for continue, repeat or stop, a press or the time limit. Needs firmware 2.11 on the main pod.

leds.label: LEDs
leds.help: Tap LEDs to switch them on or off.

ms.label: Time (ms)
ms.help: Fixed wait. Or set min and max for a random wait.

shortMs.label: Short press up to (ms)
shortMs.help: Shorter presses leave at “short”, longer ones at “long”.

metrics.label: Measurements in the round result
metrics.help: Which measurements the round result lists (none = all).

vars.label: Variables in the round result
vars.help: Their values when the round result is made.

editable.label: Editable from the app
editable.help: Variables the app may change while the block waits, within min and max.

timeoutMs.label: Time-out (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Without a press in this time the block leaves at “time-out”.

record.label: Measure as
record.help: Name of the measurement, e.g. reaction. Used by the summary.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: hit: press when lit. avoid: do not press.

pods.label: Number of pods
pods.help: Empty: all pods of the game.

show.label: Show a bar on the ring
show.help: The average as a bar on the main pod's ring for a few seconds: green = better than the target, amber = up to 1.5 times, red = slower. Needs pod firmware 2.13.

targetMs.label: Target (ms)
targetMs.help: The bar is half full at this time, empty at twice this time, full at 0 ms.

showMs.label: Show for (ms)
showMs.help: How long the bar stays. 0 = until the next light changes, and the game does not wait.

count.label: Rounds
count.help: How many times the round runs.

timerStart.label: Start stopwatch
timerStart.help: Starts this stopwatch when the step begins.

timerStop.label: Stop stopwatch
timerStop.help: When the step ends, records the time since the start under this name.

target.label: Where
target.help: central, all (central and pods), peripherals, or the number of a pod.

color2.label: Second colour
color2.help: Background or end colour of the effect. Default: off.

periodMs.label: One cycle (ms)
periodMs.help: Blink, pulse and spin: how long one turn takes.

wait.label: Wait until it is over

countdown.label: Countdown
countdown.help: Shows the time running out on the ring.

style.label: Style

solo.line: Only the main pod. Blue = get ready, then press as soon as it lights up.

star.name: Star
star.line: The main pod and a random pod take turns.

random.name: Random pod
random.line: One random pod lights up, the main pod too, never the same twice.

multi.name: All at once
multi.line: All pods light up at once. Hit every one, leave the red ones.

duo.name: Duo
duo.line: Two pods take turns after a random pause.

game.question: What do you want to play?

problems.pauseOrder: The shortest pause must be shorter than the longest.
problems.redTarget: Red is taken by the “don't touch” pods. Pick another colour for the light to hit.

pods.question: How many pods do you have?
pods.hint: Count the pods besides the main pod (the pod the app connects to).
pods.label: Pods besides the main pod
pods.soloUses: Solo uses only the main pod. Other pods stay off.
pods.duoUses: Duo uses the main pod and one pod. Other pods stay off.

timing.timeLimitOff: Wait as long as it takes

onTimeout.countMiss: Count a miss and go on

colors.target: Colour of the light to hit

measure.question: What should the pods measure?
measure.hint: All of this is optional. You can change it later.

measure.countMissesOff: Turn on a time limit first.
measure.resultsHint: Average and best time after the last round.

ready.title: Your game is ready

chooser.gameLine: Answer five questions. The app builds the game, you can try it right away.

chooser.copyLine: Take one of your games or a shipped one and change it.
chooser.noneMine: No games of your own yet.
